title: Jena Kingsley Releases Latest Book "Darcy Dates" a Single Mom's Comedic Dating Diary
text:
Comedian and social commentator offers inspiration for those who look for love and end up finding themselves NEW YORK - April 30, 2025 - Jena Kingsley, comedian and social commentator, today announced the release of her new book, “Darcy Dates” on Amazon.com. “Darcy Dates” is written as a diary, which is incredibly funny and unfiltered. The book is based on the popular 2010 blog and will be well received by the same audience that appreciates single girl characters who date, like HBO’s Carrie Bradshaw.
In the 2010’s there was Facebook, but very little social media, and no Instagram. According to Kingsley, “Darcy was written when people clung to their BlackBerry’s and Instagram did not exist.”
Darcy Dates,” is a diary, which introduces us to a divorced, single mother after having been married for seven years. She finds herself navigating the dating world on New York’s Upper East Side. Darcy encounters people who carry, “more baggage than any bellhop at the Pierre Hotel could handle,” said the author.
Darcy begins to document her dates in the form of a blog, which becomes her diary. “Darcy Dates” provides the reader with hilarious comedy, sometimes cringey, and at times emotionally touching. Kingsley shared, “You will definitely belly laugh, you may tear up. Sometimes you might want to look away, but one thing is clear, you will cheer on and support Darcy in her quest for love. As in many cases where a seeker is looking for love, Darcy finds herself in the process.”
According to Gary Belsky, the New York Times bestselling author, “Jena is the rare author who is as good at storytelling as she is at making her readers squirm from TMI and ache from belly laughs,” and Perez Hilton called her “one bold and funny lady.”
For more information and to buy “Darcy Dates,” visit JenaKingsley.com
About Jena
Jena Kingsley was born and raised in New York City. She made her television debut appearance doing standup on “Live from Gotham” on AXS TV, which landed her as a regular guest on Sirius XM. The media has called her work “Genius” and “Brilliant.” Her comedy is dedicated to her father.
She has been recognized CNN, TIME, MTV, ABC, The Today Show, USA Today, AdWeek, Perez Hilton, and CBS The Doctors. TruTV ran her “No Selfie Zone” video on their top funniest videos episode, with stand-up appearances on The Stand, Gotham Comedy Club, Levity Live, Carolines Comedy Club, Governors, and Stand Up New York.
Her comedy is dedicated to her father. Who told her she was funny. Really funny.
